expertiseSources.summary: Records the immutable upstream repository and commit, MIT license, and the boundary of the original tracker-agnostic, plan-only adaptation.

Defines normalized revision, lease, external-action authorization, receipt idempotency, reclaim inspection, human reconciliation audit, and frontier semantics exercised by the deterministic recovery checker.

exception.rationale: The workflow prevents conflicting ticket claims, stale or partial tracker synchronization, and mutable tracker content from authorizing implementation, destructive actions, or privilege escalation. These concurrency and execution-boundary controls reduce operational risk directly and are better evaluated through adversarial behavior, routing, and maintainer review than average output-quality uplift at experimental entry.
